requirements.title: Canonical project state
requirements.description: Machine-readable repository state preserves execution continuity without conversational memory.

requirements.title: Strict schema validation
requirements.description: Critical control files are validated by strict JSON Schemas and consistency checks.

requirements.title: Execution policy and guard
requirements.description: A blocking executable guard validates phase authorization, dependencies, Git state and policy.

requirements.title: Controlled lock and transitions
requirements.description: Safe locks and state transitions prevent conflicting or invalid phase execution.

requirements.title: Evidence and readiness registry
requirements.description: Durable evidence and readiness records prove every completed phase gate.

requirements.title: Quality and closure engines
requirements.description: Automated quality aggregation and guarded two-commit closure enforce GO decisions.

requirements.title: Deterministic platform foundation
requirements.description: Locked Python toolchain, minimal ASGI runtime and local infrastructure are reproducible.

requirements.title: Security automation baseline
requirements.description: Secrets, dependencies, source and container are subject to documented blocking scans.

requirements.title: Traceable engineering changes
requirements.description: Requirements, commits, branches, decisions and evidence remain auditable in Git.

requirements.title: Structured runtime visibility
requirements.description: The minimal runtime emits structured logs and provides health and version endpoints.

requirements.title: Graceful runtime lifecycle
requirements.description: The runtime handles process signals cleanly and dependencies expose health checks.

requirements.title: Backend domain foundation
requirements.description: Establish production backend boundaries, configuration and shared platform primitives.

requirements.title: Strict tenant isolation
requirements.description: Every tenant-scoped operation enforces organization isolation across data and compute.

requirements.title: Organization provisioning
requirements.description: Organizations are customer-facing tenants with automated, idempotent provisioning.

requirements.title: Dynamic organization dashboards
requirements.description: Validated organization configuration generates tenant-specific dashboard schemas.

requirements.title: Omnichannel customer identity
requirements.description: Customer identity and conversation context resolve safely across all supported channels.

requirements.title: CRM ERP and API hub
requirements.description: Provider-neutral REST, OpenAPI, GraphQL, CRM, ERP and calendar integrations are governed.

requirements.title: Controlled AI tools and actions
requirements.description: AI-requested tools execute through policy, scoped credentials, audit and idempotency controls.

requirements.title: WhatsApp channel
requirements.description: WhatsApp messaging participates in the governed omnichannel conversation model.

requirements.title: Email channel
requirements.description: Inbound and outbound email use provider abstractions and shared conversation context.

requirements.title: SMS channel
requirements.description: Inbound and outbound SMS use provider abstractions and shared conversation context.

requirements.title: One-time passwords
requirements.description: OTP issuance and verification enforce expiry, replay resistance, throttling and audit.

requirements.title: Asterisk telephony foundation
requirements.description: Inbound and outbound calling uses Asterisk behind stable provider-neutral contracts.

requirements.title: Realtime AI voice
requirements.description: Realtime voice sessions support inbound, outbound and controlled AI-human handoff.

requirements.title: ElevenLabs provider
requirements.description: ElevenLabs is integrated as a strategic realtime voice provider behind abstraction boundaries.

requirements.title: Durable workflow engine
requirements.description: Versioned workflows coordinate idempotent tools, communication and recoverable long-running work.

requirements.title: Omnichannel campaigns
requirements.description: Campaigns schedule consent-aware, throttled omnichannel outreach with measurable outcomes.

requirements.title: Human call-center operations
requirements.description: Human operators receive queues, context, copilot support and controlled AI handoff.

requirements.title: Horizontal cells
requirements.description: Stateless compute and explicit ownership permit adding another VPS or certified cell safely.

requirements.title: Kamailio SIP edge
requirements.description: Kamailio provides the planned horizontally scalable SIP edge ahead of Asterisk cells.

requirements.title: Thirty organization cell target
requirements.description: Each certified standard cell demonstrates capacity for approximately thirty standard organizations or more.

requirements.title: NXS Sentinel
requirements.description: NXS Sentinel autonomously monitors and assists governed SRE and engineering operations.

requirements.title: Credential broker isolation
requirements.description: Language models never receive direct external service credentials or unrestricted secret access.

requirements.title: Immutable platform audit
requirements.description: Security-sensitive tenant, human and AI actions produce tamper-evident auditable records.

requirements.title: End-to-end observability
requirements.description: Metrics, traces, logs, SLOs and correlation span cells, channels and tenant operations.

requirements.title: Failure resilience
requirements.description: The platform tolerates dependency and cell failures with tested degradation and recovery.

requirements.title: Backup and restore
requirements.description: Encrypted backups and regularly tested restores meet declared recovery objectives.
